description:
Invite a new user to the account, with a role. The invitee gets an email with a link to set their password.

Client users invite to their own client account, partner users to the partner account. To create a new client
together with its first user, use 'create_client_and_invite'.

The user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

name.description: Full name of the person to invite.

role.description: Role to give the new user. 'partner-owner' or 'partner-member' on a partner account, 'client-owner' or 'client-member' on a client account. Owners can invite users and manage the account; members can use it but not manage users.

name: invite_user
title: Invite user
